title: OpenAPS SMB Dynamic ISF, SMB reports limiting max_iob to 1.5U (not following preference settings?)
body:
**AndroidAPS version**: 10
**Build number**: 3.0.0.1-dev-8, build fef8421e7
**Flavor**: fullrelease

## Phone: ##

Samsung Note 9

## Problem description: ##
While testing OpenAPS SMB Dynamic ISF I noticed staying on high BG's for far to long while 0-Temping and SMB not kicking in. Looking into this found the SMB tab reporting constraints "_Safety: Limiting IOB to 1.5U because of max value in preferences_". 

When switched back to standard "OpenAPS SMB" constraint reported "_Safety: Limiting IOB to 8.0U because of max value in preferences_" as expected.

Looks like OpenAPS SMB Dynamic ISF is not following the settings from preferences?
Unless this is part of the "Dynamic ISF" functionality, I would say that is a bug?

_Additional information and reproduction steps:_

Using "Sensitivity Oref1" or "OpenAPS AMA" 

1. Make sure "_OpenAPS SMB_" is selected for APS
2. Under preferences, make a note of max_iob settings
3. Check the SBM tab under constraints. It should report a limiting value as configured in setting  under (2)
4. Switch to the new "_OpenAPS SMB Dynamic ISF_" plugin
5. Under preferences, check if the max_iob settings is showing?
6. Check the SBM tab under constraints. Confirm It now reports a limiting value for max_iob, different form settings.

In general, I notice SMB is not kicking in while IOB is over 1.5U
